lessons: Scope fence misses forced files: tests/unit/test_menu_admission.py:194 and tests/unit/test_verdict_menu_parity.py:42 patch Path.read_text with a ticket-only dict, so snapshot's required Path.read_text doc read raises KeyError and `./dev.py test` (criterion 14) fails.

Before rerunning, add tests/unit/test_menu_admission.py and tests/unit/test_verdict_menu_parity.py to the fence and Scope in. Allow only fixture changes that serve the packaged chupa/docs text (or the real read_text for paths under chupa/docs); their assertions stay the same.
Those fixtures also patch Path.is_file and Path.exists to ticket paths. If chupa/help.py checks a packaged doc exists before reading it, the fixture change must cover that check too.

Do not dodge the fakes by binding Path.read_text at import time or caching the help map at import. The Goal requires the run-guide verb text to be read at snapshot time, and either trick only hides a fixture that needs updating.
